FN-MV2BHHH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 169
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Matt Woods
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/26/2024
House Bill 169 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) the local
boards of education to post each school's adopted curricula for each class on the school's
website; (2) the local superintendents of education to verify and/or post adopted curricula of
certain schools on the website, receive complaints of non-compliance of teachers, and file
annually with the State Superintendent of Education the number of complaints received
regarding non-compliance with the provisions of this bill; and (3) the State Superintendent of
Education to post adopted curricula of certain schools on the website, and receive and report the
number of complaints received pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
